help.stdout:
**ζ-3 (2026-05-11)** — Diff two `dream snapshot` memories. Reads both `kind=snapshot` rows, parses content as JSON (schema_version=1), detects which one is older, prints structured deltas for every section: memory counts, coactivation distribution, top persistent, top-10 access, identity tools/saves, transitions. Designed to make "what did I change about myself between these two timestamps" answerable in one command.

Order-independent: caller can pass the two keys in any order; the command swaps them so the diff is always "older → newer".

**ζ-16 (2026-05-12)** — `--auto` skips the key arguments and pulls the two most-recent `snapshot_daily_*` rows from the store. Pairs with the ζ-10 daily cron so a one-word `dream diff --auto` shows the last 24h hygiene net effect.

Usage: agent-bridge dream diff [OPTIONS] [KEY_A] [KEY_B]

Arguments:
  [KEY_A]
          First snapshot memory key. Required unless `--auto` is set

  [KEY_B]
          Second snapshot memory key. Required unless `--auto` is set

Options:
      --auto
          ζ-16 — fetch the two most-recent active `snapshot_daily_*` memories and diff them. Errors out if fewer than 2 exist yet

      --json
          Emit raw JSON deltas instead of pretty text. Useful for piping into other tools

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
